outliner.description: Organize your thoughts with hierarchical outlines. Perfect for planning projects, meeting notes, and brainstorming.

terminal.description: Lightning-fast terminal interface built with Ratatui. Navigate your notes without leaving the terminal.
terminal.screenshotDescription: Terminal interface showing note list and preview

cli.title: Powerful CLI Commands
cli.description: Command-line tools for quick note operations and automation.
cli.code:
jottery note
jottery list
jottery search "query"
jottery show <id>
jottery sync

piping.title: Pipe Content Directly
piping.description: Capture command output as notes instantly. Perfect for logging and documentation.
piping.code:
echo "Quick note" | jottery note
ls -la | jottery note -t system,logs
cat error.log | jottery note -t errors

security.title: How Your Data Works
security.lead: Jottery keeps things simple. Your notes live on your device, and you're always in control.

encryption.title: Encrypted at Rest
encryption.description: Your notes are encrypted on your device using your password. This protects your data if the device is lost or compromised.

selfHosted.title: Self-Hostable
selfHosted.description: Run your own sync server for multi-device access. The server stores encrypted data it cannot read.

noTracking.title: No Third Parties
noTracking.description: No analytics, no tracking, no external services. The app works entirely on your device.

finalCta.title: Ready to Get Started?
